title: Search and shell tools: glob, grep, bash
description: Implement glob (file pattern matching via fast-glob or similar), grep (content search via ripgrep child process or string matching), bash (shell command execution with stdout/stderr capture, timeout support). These are discovery and execution tools — the agent uses them to explore the codebase and run commands.
design: Consumes: Tool interface from sc-382, registry from sc-zdk. Produces: codebase exploration and command execution capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: glob returns matching file paths. grep supports pattern + glob filter + output modes (files/content). bash captures exit code + stdout + stderr, respects timeout. Tests pass.

title: Session logging middleware
description: Implement src/logging/session.ts (SessionLogger: creates JSONL file in .scuffy/sessions/, appends LogEvent per line) and src/agent/middleware.ts (Middleware interface, LoggingMiddleware that wraps all events, TimeAwarenessMiddleware that injects current time + elapsed gaps). This must be wired up before the agent loop so logging exists from the first run.
design: Consumes: LogEvent types from sc-382, Middleware interface. Produces: LoggingMiddleware and TimeAwarenessMiddleware used by agent loop (sc-next). Satisfies PRD tracing requirement.
acceptance_criteria: JSONL file created per session in .scuffy/sessions/. Every LLM call, tool call, tool result produces a log line. TimeAwareness injects current timestamp into system context. Tests pass.

title: CLI REPL and wiring
description: Implement src/cli/repl.ts — persistent readline loop that accepts user instructions, creates/resumes sessions, calls runAgentLoop, displays results. Wire everything together in src/index.ts: parse args/env, create registry, register all tools, create middleware stack, start REPL. The agent must run continuously and accept new instructions without restarting (PRD MVP requirement #1).
design: Consumes: runAgentLoop from sc-38a, all tools, all middleware. Produces: working CLI agent (PRD MVP requirement #1).
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev starts the agent. User can type instructions, agent responds. Multiple instructions in one session without restart. Ctrl+C exits cleanly. Session JSONL written.

title: Rework requirements extraction from PRD
description: Revisit REQUIREMENTS.md and re-extract from shipyard_prd.pdf with full fidelity. Current extraction paraphrased some requirements incorrectly. Needs to be done before early submission planning.
design: Consumes: Tool interface from sc-382, registry from sc-zdk. Produces: codebase exploration and command execution capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: glob returns matching file paths. grep supports pattern + glob filter + output modes (files/content). bash captures exit code + stdout + stderr, respects timeout. Tests pass.

title: Project scaffold and type foundations
description: Initialize package.json, tsconfig.json (strict), vitest.config.ts, eslint config. Create src/tools/types.ts (Tool, ToolResult, ToolCall interfaces), src/logging/types.ts (LogEvent union type), src/config.ts (AgentConfig, model selection from env), src/index.ts (stub). All Zod schemas for tool parameters.
design: Consumes: nothing (foundational). Produces: Tool interface, ToolResult, ToolContext, LogEvent, AgentConfig types used by every other task.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes. All core interfaces exported. AgentConfig reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and SCUFFY_MODEL from env.
close_reason: Project scaffold and core type foundations. All interfaces exported, typecheck/lint/test pass.

title: Agent loop and context assembly
description: Implement src/agent/loop.ts — the core cycle: assemble messages, call Claude API via @anthropic-ai/sdk, if tool_use blocks in response execute tools via registry and loop, if text response return as final answer. Implement src/agent/context.ts — builds system prompt, injects current time (TimeAwareness), assembles conversation history, handles context injection (specs/schemas/prior output as tagged blocks in user messages). Wire middleware pipeline: before/after LLM call, before/after tool execution. Integration test with mock LLM responses.
design: Consumes: ToolRegistry from sc-zdk, Middleware from sc-2bt, all tools. Produces: runAgentLoop() — the core function everything else calls.
acceptance_criteria: Agent loop calls Claude API, executes tool calls, loops until text response. Context injection works (tagged blocks in user messages). Middleware pipeline fires in order. maxIterations safety cap works. Integration test passes.

title: Subagent support: task tool
description: Implement src/tools/task.ts — the task tool that spawns ephemeral subagents. Main agent calls task({name, prompt}) and gets back a result string. Subagent gets its own agent loop invocation with the same tool registry but isolated message history. Supports spawning multiple subagents in parallel via parallel tool calls. Default general-purpose subagent available. Satisfies PRD multi-agent coordination requirement.
design: Consumes: runAgentLoop from sc-38a, ToolRegistry from sc-zdk. Produces: multi-agent capability (PRD MVP requirement, CODEAGENT.md Multi-Agent Design section).
acceptance_criteria: task tool spawns a subagent that can use all registered tools. Subagent returns result to parent. Parallel subagent spawning works. Session log captures subagent events. Test with a subagent that reads a file and reports contents.

title: File tools: readFile, editFile, writeFile
description: Implement the three file operation tools. readFile: read with line numbers, offset/limit pagination. editFile: anchor-based str_replace with uniqueness check, read-before-edit enforcement via ToolContext.fileReadTimestamps, replace_all flag. writeFile: full file write for new files/rewrites. Unit tests for edit uniqueness rejection, read-before-edit rejection, stale file detection.
design: Consumes: Tool interface, ToolContext from sc-382, registry from sc-zdk. Produces: the surgical editing capability (PRD MVP requirement #2).
acceptance_criteria: editFile rejects: not-found, multiple-match (unless replace_all), unread file, stale file. readFile supports offset/limit. writeFile creates parent dirs. All tests pass.

title: CODEAGENT.md MVP sections
description: Fill in the MVP-due sections of CODEAGENT.md: Agent Architecture (diagram/description of loop, tools, state management, entry/exit conditions, error branches), File Editing Strategy (step-by-step mechanism, how it locates the correct block, what happens on wrong location), Multi-Agent Design (orchestration model, communication, output merging), Trace Links (two shared trace links showing different execution paths — one normal run, one error/branching). Content comes from PRESEARCH.md and ARCHITECTURE.md plus actual trace output from running the agent.
design: Consumes: running agent from sc-2ji, session logs. Produces: CODEAGENT.md deliverable (PRD MVP requirement #7).
acceptance_criteria: CODEAGENT.md has all four MVP sections filled with specific, evidence-backed content. Trace links point to actual JSONL session logs showing two different execution paths.

title: Tool registry and basic tools
description: Implement src/tools/registry.ts — register tools, look up by name, convert to Anthropic API tool format from Zod schemas. Implement src/tools/think.ts (no-op scratchpad) and src/tools/listDir.ts as first tools to prove the registry works. Unit tests for registry (register, lookup, duplicate rejection, Anthropic format generation).
design: Consumes: Tool interface from sc-382. Produces: ToolRegistry class used by agent loop and all tool tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Registry converts Zod schemas to Anthropic tool definitions. think and listDir registered and callable. Tests pass.
